authority_note: GPT-Knowledge is a projection of verified repository/runtime evidence. Current repository source, local runtime evidence and acceptance results remain authoritative.

current_architecture.reasoning_owner: LiveAgentCore / provider remains responsible for strategy and tool choice.
current_architecture.runtime_owner: Runtime owns lifecycle, governed execution, evidence and terminal truth, but does not yet own material-progress reconciliation.
current_architecture.key_gap: After a successful tool result the provider may request the same action again without a deterministic state-delta/no-progress interlock.

proven_findings.detail: fcb533d preload normalization restored semantic execution.tool.started/execution.tool.completed delivery to the legacy renderer.
turn-37c41f6e450f190f repeatedly completed browserConversationRead without reaching terminal progress and later remained durable state executing.

test/agent-runtime-no-progress-smoke.js at b2b6ff3 expects second duplicate observation to block, but current runtime returned completed. This proves the reconciliation contract is absent before implementation.
browserSnapshot does not send raw HTML. It returns bounded visible text plus visible interactive nodes with temporary aa-N refs and metadata.

Browser navigation readiness currently relies on document.readyState interactive/complete. Non-navigation DOM click waits a fixed 100 ms before returning downstreamOutcome UNVERIFIED; no network/mutation/hydration settlement contract is proven.
Managed Chrome launches with a reusable Access-owned --user-data-dir profile. This preserves transport login state but does not isolate general browsing state per task.

Current snapshot derives semantics from DOM selectors/aria-label/title/innerText/value/placeholder. Native Chromium Accessibility.getFullAXTree and screenshot dual perception are not current declared capabilities.

active.title: P1 Runtime Progress / Re-entry Contract
active.question: Can identical tool observations be detected between tool completion and the next provider.complete() without taking reasoning ownership away from the model or polluting durable conversation history?
active.falsifier: If the runtime still invokes a fourth provider completion after initial observation plus two identical duplicates, the progress guard is not implemented.

hardening_plan.title: Deterministic progress/re-entry guard
hardening_plan.target: LiveAgentCore between execution.tool.completed and next provider.complete()
add: consecutive duplicate counter scoped to active step
transient provider-facing RUNTIME_NO_STATE_CHANGE notice on first duplicate
change: provider.complete() input may include one transient runtime notice without persisting it
global 40-call budget remains final fuse, not progress detection
remove: dependence on provider self-detecting identical observation loops

hardening_plan.title: Bounded browser settlement contract
change: replace fixed post-click wait(100) as the primary settlement mechanism

hardening_plan.title: Persistent relay identity + isolated task contexts
change: general browser tools should not automatically inherit all persistent transport state
remove: implicit assumption that one persistent profile is suitable for both relay identity and arbitrary task browsing
do_not_touch: persistent ChatGPT login/profile required by Browser Relay

hardening_plan.title: Native AX tree + optional visual perception
add: CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree or bounded AX equivalent
stable semantic refs mapped to actionable DOM targets
optional browserScreenshot capability for layout/CSS/canvas verification
change: custom DOM semantic approximation becomes fallback/supporting projection rather than sole semantic source
remove: claim that current aa-N DOM map is a native accessibility tree

pending.detail: Failing regression proves the no-progress contract is absent. Implement smallest kernel and make this regression pass before live Browser Loop revalidation.
Replace readyState + fixed 100ms interaction delay with bounded transition settlement and fresh state revision.
turn-37c41f6e450f190f remains an evidence-backed recovery item until explicit reconciliation receipt is observed.
Prove Agent Stop produces durable stopped/cancelled state and does not leave Browser Relay instruction journal executing.
Resume BLOCKED/FAILED/STOPPED UI truth acceptance once runtime termination/reconciliation is controlled.
AttachConsole failed after prolonged runtime. Keep separate until causal ownership is proven.

next_acceptance.question: Does the Phase-1 progress guard stop initial observation + two identical duplicates before a fourth provider completion while keeping the runtime warning transient?
next_acceptance.observable: agent-runtime-no-progress-smoke PASS, existing agent-runtime-resilience-smoke PASS, no durable RUNTIME_NO_STATE_CHANGE message, and no regression to failed-tool adaptation.
next_acceptance.falsifier: Any fourth provider completion, durable injected runtime notice, or loss of normal failed-tool recovery keeps the gate open.
